owner_words: Make the emoji icon show a random actual emoji (with a few emoji blacklisted from showing as the icon that are often used for suggestive purposes 🤬💦🔞🍑🍆 etc)
The + icon should be an SVG and significantly larger. The emoji icon shouldn't have a background when not selected
And flags blacklisted too because a) they don't work on windows b) political controversy

reference.kind: Owner crop of current composer controls, not a completed-design illustration

requirements: The emoji trigger displays a randomly selected genuine emoji sequence from the canonical emoji data. Exclude the explicit examples and other clearly suggestive trigger candidates; exclude ALL flags, including generic, country and subdivision flag sequences.
Apply this eligibility policy to the random trigger-icon pool. Preserve canonical emoji data and existing picker/search/insertion behavior.
Unselected emoji trigger has no visible background; preserve focus visibility, accessible name, hit target and genuine picker-open selected state.
Replace tiny font plus with a genuine packaged SVG plus, substantially larger in the existing centered accessible target. Preserve action and theme foreground; follow filled/rounded icon refinement.
CUI owns app presentation and state; use generic typed framework/data capabilities, not new app C# presentation caches or hidden orchestration. One shared composer in standalone/Haven.
routine_implementation_assumption: Choose once per mounted composer and retain the emoji across typing, ordinary binding refresh, focus and theme changes; independent instances may randomly choose the same candidate. This is an implementation choice, not an owner quotation.
rendering_limit: Current bundled NotoEmoji supports actual Unicode glyphs but is monochrome; no cross-platform color-rendering acceptance is implied.
